explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/867: if A ⊆ [1,N] has no a_i + … + a_j ∈ A (i < j), is |A| ≤ N/2 + O(1)? The page says this is false (Freud: density ≥ 19/36). ConsecutiveSumFree encodes runs of consecutive elements as A ∩ [m,n] with at least 2 elements, which is equivalent. The statement negates the existence of a uniform C. Faithful.
